subject: Air freight quote request to MEL
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to MEL (Melbourne, AU), including collection from our site in postcode 71279 (Boeblingen), Germany? Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 10 pieces of textile samples, with a gross weight of 1530 kg and a total volume of 9.71 cbm. It will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-24.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including pickup and trucking to the airport.

Thank you in advance.

Our budget for this shipment is around 3300 EUR all-in, so I hope you can get close to that.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
